newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan falls to record low in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan falls to record low in active trade.

text.p: Shares of retailer Yaohan Japan Corp tumbled briefly to an all-time low of 133 yen in the face of aggressive selling on Wednesday morning, but had regained some ground by the afternoon, brokers said.

As of 0449 GMT, Yaohan's shares were down by 21 yen to 152 yen. They had earlier plunged to 133 yen in the morning session amid active sales, surpassing the previous record low of 173 yen marked on the previous day.
The retailer's turnover was 3.50 million, the fourth biggest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Behind the drop were persistent market jitters over the financial health of the Japanese retailer, burdened with hefty borrowings after aggressive expansion overseas. But no major fresh selling factors were detected on Wednesday.
